source: User-provided peer v0.67 packaged material library

conversion: stored float32 * 32767, truncate to signed PCM16; 48 kHz mono, 0.45 seconds; no additional processing
recognition: v0.4.0: in-process in-match matcher (onset-anchored, pre-onset background subtraction, mel bands 16-55); group thresholds .82 with five short/noise-like references at .90, automatic single-event minimum .86; no putdown auxiliary matching. The Go SoundRadar index is no longer bundled. v0.4.3: peer-047 and peer-051 relinked from the 红外线理疗灯 / 天线 pickups to the 琥珀天心-class (13 items) and 定位组 (9 items) putdown/transfer sounds; 红外线理疗灯 and 天线 added to the matching pickup groups. v0.4.5: query anchors = scanner onset plus every sharp high-band rise within 224 ms (an interface click may open the event 0.10-0.16 s before the item sound); tail 0.45 s; multi-variant templates per class (see additionalReferences).
